**Our Team**
 The Netflix Ads Identity and Audiences team is committed to providing a relevant and engaging advertising experience that prioritizes member privacy. Our mission is to maintain accurate member identities, ensuring that ads are both engaging and compliant with consumer privacy choices and regional regulations.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Privacy Software Engineer on the Ads Identity and Audiences team, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding Netflix member privacy across the Netflix Ads Suite. Your primary focus will be on designing and implementing privacy\-preserving technologies that ensure ads are not only engaging but also fully respectful of consumer privacy choices and compliant with regional regulations.
   

  

 In this dynamic and innovative environment, your contributions will have a significant impact on how we protect member data and privacy. You will collaborate with a team of talented professionals who are deeply passionate about technology and privacy, fostering a culture that values creativity, diversity, and continuous learning.
   

  

**Skills \& Experience We’re Seeking**
* Professional experience in designing and building privacy features for ad platforms, with a focus on user data protection and compliance.
* Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and security concepts, including Privacy by Design principles.
* Experience with implementing data privacy protections such as data minimization, encryption, and deidentification techniques.
* In\-depth knowledge of regional privacy regulations, e.g. GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act), and CPRA (California Privacy Rights Act).
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, C\+\+, or similar, with a strong grasp of software development principles and design patterns.
* Experience in developing distributed cloud\-based applications and proficiency in modern programming languages, preferably object\-oriented.
* Proven experience in handling data at extremely large volumes with big data tools like Spark, and building high throughput low latency distributed systems that utilized the big data.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and effectively manage multiple priorities.
* Knowledge of the ad tech and advertising landscape, including programmatic advertising and digital marketing trends.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams.


**Nice To Haves**
* Experience with Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PETs)
* Experience integrating with Consent Management Platforms (CMPs)
* Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints.
* Contribution to ad tech privacy industry groups (e.g. IAB Tech Lab).

Join Axon and Be a Force for Good
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities, and each other.
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging, and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. You’ll constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters and a company where you matter.
Your Impact
As a Software Engineer at Axon, you’ll help build technology that supports mission-critical products used by customers around the world.
We are hiring engineers across a range of experience levels. Depending on your background, you may be growing your skills alongside experienced engineers, independently owning features and services, or leading technical design and architecture for complex systems.
You’ll work in a collaborative, AI-first engineering environment where modern development tools, automation, and AI-assisted workflows are part of how we build software. You’ll partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and other teams to solve meaningful customer problems while building reliable, scalable technology.
Whether you are early in your career or an experienced engineer, we are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, care about quality, and want to continue growing.
What You’ll Do
Depending on your experience and the team you join, you may:
Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain production software and services
Own features and technical projects from requirements through production
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture design
Build highly available, scalable, and performant systems for mission-critical products
Work with modern cloud, distributed systems, data, and open-source technologies
Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to build solutions that solve real customer problems
Use AI-assisted development tools, automation, and intelligent workflows to improve engineering productivity and software quality
Validate and critically evaluate AI-generated code and technical recommendations
Improve testing, observability, reliability, and operational efficiency
Contribute to engineering processes and technical best practices
Learn from experienced engineers and share your knowledge with others
At more senior levels, provide technical leadership, influence architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and help raise the technical bar across teams
What You Bring
We know great engineers come from many different backgrounds. Relevant experience may come from professional roles, internships, academic work, military experience, open-source contributions, boot camps, or other hands-on software development.
We’re interested in candidates who bring some combination of:
A foundation in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience programming in languages such as Java, Go, Scala, C#, Python, C++, or similar
Experience or interest in building backend services, APIs, cloud applications, distributed systems, or other production software
Familiarity with SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
An understanding of software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and system design appropriate to your experience level
Curiosity about modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development, code generation, and automation
A commitment to writing reliable, maintainable, and high-quality software
Strong problem-solving and communication skills
A desire to understand customer problems and build technology that makes a meaningful impact
For more experienced engineers, we may also look for:
Experience designing and delivering highly available, scalable cloud-based systems
Ownership of production services and complex technical projects
Strong system design and architecture experience
Experience making and communicating engineering tradeoffs
Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction
Experience improving developer workflows through automation or AI-assisted engineering practices
